username.title: Email
username.description: The email address used in the myVAILLANT / MiGo Link app.

password.title: Password
password.description: The password used in the myVAILLANT / MiGo Link app.

country.title: Country
country.description: Country of your account, lowercase English name (e.g. germany, france, spain, italy).

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to refresh device state from the cloud (minimum 60).

whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only the devices in the list will be exposed. If the list is empty, all the devices will be exposed.

blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: The devices in the list will not be exposed. If the list is empty, no devices will be excluded.

debug.title: Enable Debug
debug.description: Enable debug mode for the plugin.

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown. Only for debugging purposes.
